title: Restore a stalled message consumer
preconditions: Confirm growing or elevated queue depth
Identify the running consumer reporting stalled acknowledgements
investigation: Inspect consumer logs and configured concurrency
Confirm the queue service is running and trace the consumer dependency

remediation.reason: Restart the stalled consumer so queued messages can be acknowledged and drained

follow_up: Investigate consumer blocking and acknowledgement handling; restarting does not replace a durable code fix.
